# Evommune to Present at Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 09, 2026 8:05am EST


PALO ALTO, Calif. & NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Evommune, Inc. (NYSE: EVMN) (the “Company” or “Evommune”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing innovative therapies that target key drivers of chronic inflammatory diseases, today announced presentations by management at the following upcoming investor conferences:


- **Stifel Healthcare Conference 2026 in New York:** Fireside Chat on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 4:40 p.m. ET.
- **2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London:** Presentation on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 6:00 a.m. ET (11:00 a.m. GMT)
- **9th Annual Evercore Healthcare Conference in Coral Gables, FL:** Fireside Chat on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at 10:25 a.m. ET.


All webcasted presentations will be available on the News & Events section of the Company’s website at[www.evommune.com](https://www.evommune.com/) . Archived replays will be available for 30 days.


**About Evommune, Inc.**


Evommune, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing innovative therapies that target key drivers of chronic inflammatory diseases. The Company’s mission is to improve patients’ daily lives and prevent the long-term effects of uncontrolled inflammation that result from the limitations of existing therapies. For more information, please visit[www.evommune.com](https://www.evommune.com/) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/evommune/) .
